primitives.name: Train Progression Operator
primitives.verbatim_quote: Slowly, like a long serpent, the train twists along up the bank of the river to the starting-point, and every now and then we enliven its progress with a cheer, which is heartily answered by our Harvard rivals.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'t': 'time in seconds', 's(t)': 'position along riverbank in meters', 'v(t)': 'velocity in m/s'}
primitives.assumptions: Train moves continuously with variable velocity; spatial path modeled as smooth curve.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When t → ∞, s(t) approaches fixed starting point.

layer2.mapping: Maps sequential train movement to race anticipation state transition in GSE.
layer2.telemetry: Cheer frequency and response amplitude as proxy for spectator engagement.

primitives.name: Boat Launch Sequence
primitives.verbatim_quote: Steadily they bear the fragile thing out to the side of the float, and we just catch a gleam from its shining side as the men turn it into the water.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'m_b': 'boat mass in kg', 'F': 'force applied by oars in N', 'a(t)': 'acceleration in m/s²'}
primitives.assumptions: Boat enters water with initial momentum; force applied uniformly over time.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When F → 0, a(t) → 0 and v(t) stabilizes.

layer2.mapping: Isomorphic to GSE's launch-state initialization with dynamic constraints.
layer2.telemetry: Time-to-water entry and boat orientation angle.

primitives.name: Spectator Engagement Index
primitives.verbatim_quote: Yale!" echo the cheers from car after car along the line.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'E': 'engagement index dimensionless', 'C_i': 'cheer intensity per car in decibels', 'n_c': 'number of cars in train'}
primitives.assumptions: Engagement increases linearly with cheer intensity and train length.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When C_i → 0, E → 0; when n_c → ∞, E → ∞.

layer2.mapping: Maps collective vocalization to GSI's confidence-weighted event prediction.
layer2.telemetry: Peak cheer amplitude and propagation delay across train cars.
